starting_state_note: Batch 09 is recorded locally with its passing full gate. Its refresh leaves two ready fields: Mondince FM316 stiffness and VeloBuild CX-002 2023 stiffness.
selection_basis: Fresh npm run --silent data:gaps and npm run --silent research:queue after Batch 09. These are the only two remaining ready fields; each has one unused web-channel attempt before its third distinct web attempt.
research_instructions: Search one exact model/source at a time and use only the one listed remaining web attempt per field.
Accept stiffness only from an instrumented measurement or credible controlled comparison that identifies the exact model revision.
Keep generic marketing, unrelated sibling models, and qualitative impressions out of the stiffness field.
If no qualifying result appears, mark both web channels temporarily exhausted with a concrete reopening trigger; do not imply no results means a zero value.
No XHS, seller contact, private content, purchase, image download, image-rights inference, external GitHub mutation, or publication.
done_criteria: Complete the two frozen exact-model checks, accept only exact measurement/comparison evidence, update each ledger within its three-attempt channel limit, write a dated result matrix, accept monotonic coverage if ledger changes require it, run npm run check once for this coherent batch, and run npm run image:report only if image records change.
delivery_boundary: Local worktree only. No push, pull request, merge, publication, or production change.
